name: ibima-auth-service
description: Standalone login/auth backend for car-damage-insurance-web-app's role-based portals (claim-workshop, claim-surveyor, preinspection-agent, preinspection-surveyor). Kept fully separate from ../server (the AI ILA backend) so the two are easy to tell apart -- different folder, different port, different DB file, different PM2 process name.
